book.name: Johaanas
book.title: Khoes khabar djaise Johaanas liekhies hai

content: Khoelal kabar
Tab hapta ke pahiela rodj sabere sabere Magdaala sahar ke Maria kabar lage gail. Abbe andhiaar raha. Aur djab oe pahoetjal tab dekhe hai kie kabar ke aage ke ieta hataawal hai!
Tab haalie se dhaurke Siemon Petras aur Jiesoe ke pjaara tjela ke lage gail aur bolies: „Koi Prabhoe ke kabar me se niekaas leis! Aur hamlog na djaaniela oesab oke kaaha dharies hai.”
Tab Petras aur ekwa tjela gail dekhe.
Doeno haalie haalie tjalat raha, bakie ekwa Petras se aur haalie dhaural. Oe sab se pahiele kabar lage pahoetjal.
Tab djab oe niehoerke taakies tab khaalie kapphan dekhies. Bakie oe bhiettar na gail.
Tab okare patjhwe Siemon Petras bhie aail aur kabar me gail. Ohoe khaalie kapphan dekhies,
aur bhie dekhies kie moerie ke pattie doesar kapra lage na hai, bakie lapetke alag dharal hai.
Tab ekwa bhie bhiettar gail. Tab sab tjiedj dekhke oe bieswaas kare lagal.
Aisane Parmeswar ke poestak me liekhal raha, bakie oelog ie baat na samdjhat raha.
Tab oesab lautke ghare tjal gail.
Jiesoe kaise apane ke dekhaais
Maria kabar ke bahare thara hoike rowat raha. Tab roite niehoerke kabar me taakies
aur dekhe hai doeigo swarag ke parie oeddjar kapra me baithal hai. Ekgo moerwaarie aur ekgo gorwaarie baithal raha.
Tab oesab poetjhies: „Bahien, toe kaahe ke rowe hai?” Tab Maria bolies: „Koi hamaar Prabhoe ke legail aur ham na djaaniela oesab oke kaaha dharies hai.”
Etane me oe ghoemke dekhies kie koi hoewa thara hai. Bakie oe na djaanies kie Jiesoe hai.

Tab Jiesoe poetjhies: „Bahien, toe kaahe ke rowe hai? Toe ke ke khodje hai?” Maria sotjies kie oe djagaha ke dekh-bhaal kare waala hai aur bolies: „Bhaai, djab toe oke legaile hoihe, tab bataai de kie oke kaaha dharle. Tab ham oke liaabe.”
Tab oe bolies: „Maria.” Tab Maria ghoemke aapan bhaasa me bolies: „Raboenie!” Ekar matlab hai: „‘Maastar djie!”’

Tab oe bolies: „Hamaar gor na pakar. Ham aapan Baap ke paas abbe na gailie hai. Dja hamaar bieswaasie bhaai log ke paas aur oesabse bataai de kie ham halieje aapan Baap ke paas oeppar djaabe. Oe toelogke Baap bhie hai. Ham aapan Parmeswar ke paas oeppar djaab. Oe tohoelogke Parmeswar hai.”
Maria gail tjela log se bataawe kie oe Prabhoe ke dekhies hai aur oe ka bolies hai.

Ohie etwaar ke raat me tjela log ekattha baithal raha. Oelog dharam ke barkwan ke deraat raha, ohie se oesab kamaarie band kar deis raha. Tab Jiesoe aaike oesabke bietj me thara bhail! Oe bolies: „Sjaantie se rahoe.”
Aur oe aapan haath aur padjarie dekhaais. Tab oelog oke dekhke etana khoesie bhail!
Tab oe phien se bolies: „Sjaantie se rahoe. Djaise hamaar Baap hamme pathaais raha, oisahie ham toelogke bhie pathaabe.”
Ie baat bolke oe oelogke oeppar phoekke bolies: „Pawietr Aatma ke apana le.
Djab toelog koi ke boeraai maaf kar deihe, tab oe be-kasoer hoi djaai. Aur djab toelog maaf na kariehe, tab oe kasoerwaar rahie djaai.”
Jiesoe aur Tomaas
Jiesoe ke baara tjela me se ekgo ke naam Tomaas raha. Oe bhie „‘djorwa”’ bolaawal djaat raha. Djab Jiesoe apane ke dekhaais raha tab Tomaas oesabke sanghe na raha.

Tab oesab ose bolies: „Hamlog Prabhoe ke dekhlie hai!” Bakie oe bolies: „Djab lek ham khiella ke tjienha okar haath par na dekhke tjhoebe, aur djab lek ham aapan haath se okar padjarie ke tjienha na tjhoei sakab, tab talak ham na bieswaas karab.”

Ek hapta baad tjela log phien ohie ghar me ekattha baithal raha. Tomaas bhie oelogke saath raha, aur sab kamaarie band raha. Tab Jiesoe phien aaike oelogke bietj me thara bhail aur bolies: „Sjaantie se rahoe.”
Aur Tomaas se bolies: „Hamaar haath taak aur aapan oengrie se tjhoew. Aapan haath lapkaaw aur hamaar padjarie par dhar. Aur ab se toe be-bieswaasie na rahoe bakie bieswaas kar.”
Tab Tomaas bolies: „Aap hamaar Prabhoe aur hamaar Parmeswar baato!”
Tab oe bolies: „Hamme dekhke toke bieswaas paral. Aur ketana soekh me oelog rahie djaun biena hamme dekhe bieswaas karie.”
Ie poestak ke matlab
Jiesoe aapan tjela ke aakhie ke saamne auro barka kaam karies hai, bakie ie poestak me sab na liekhal hai.
Ie liekhaail hai djeme toelog bieswaas kariehe kie Jiesoe Parmeswar ke Kriest aur okar Beta hai. Aur ie baat bieswaas kare se toelog okar naam ke saktie dwaara sattja djiewan bietaai sakiehe.
